1. Project: apple-glass-portfolio is a Next.js 16 glassmorphism portfolio website with hero and social cards.
2. The main entry file is src/app/page.tsx which composes HeroCard and all social cards in order.
3. HeroCard is implemented in src/components/Hero/HeroCard.tsx and includes avatar, contact buttons, and status.
4. CardContainer in src/components/SocialCard/CardContainer.tsx controls both mobile and desktop card rendering.
5. Mobile cards use the same gradient, shadow, border, and glow intensity as the hero card when detected.
6. Desktop cards keep the original glass-panel hover and tilt animations for laptops and larger screens.
7. useCardState in src/lib/useCardState.ts fetches /api/card-state with cache: no-store to keep data fresh.
8. Live GitHub data is pulled from /api/github and /api/github/contributions in GitHubCard.tsx.
9. YouTube stats are fetched from /api/youtube with cache: no-store for consistent updates on mobile and desktop.
10. Instagram profile and posts are fetched from /api/instagram and /api/instagram/posts, also no-store.
11. Facebook card data is refreshed from /api/facebook/page and displayed with animated follower and like values.
12. Discord card uses SSE for live updates from /api/discord and falls back to polling every 30 seconds.
13. The app uses Tailwind CSS 4 and global styles in src/app/globals.css to define glassmorphism utilities.
14. Mobile specific CSS in globals.css disables backdrop-filter and hover reflections for better touch performance.
15. The project includes an optional bot script at bot/bot.ts that is separate from the main portfolio UI.
16. Package versions are defined in package.json, including next 16.2.11, react 19.2.4, and framer-motion 12.42.2.
17. The README has been supplemented with sa roy.md and a separate 10000-line detail file per request.
18. Deployment can happen on Vercel or any Next.js-compatible host, with static and dynamic routes supported.
19. The card accent colors are defined in src/data/socialData.ts for each social platform card.
20. Every process step should be documented, and this text file is built to meet the requested high line count.
